metadata.description: The schedule 5 and 6 provides for special protection to the tribals in the country. There are many other laws made by the parliament for the tribal rights. Every law made for tribals have a history of struggle behind it. Even before independence tribals fought for their rights and British rulers were forced to make special laws for tribal areas.
